_meta.note: Value chain data for water recycling. Metrics are treatment cost, recovery, recycling share, energy, leakage.

treatment_cost_usd_per_m3.label: Treatment Cost
treatment_cost_usd_per_m3.source: OCWD Annual Report FY2023-24 (operational cost data)

water_recovery_pct.label: Water Recovery Rate
water_recovery_pct.source: OCWD GWRS System Fact Sheet (MF recovery ~90%; RO ~85% net)

recycling_share_pct.label: Recycling Share of Supply
recycling_share_pct.source: OCWD Annual Report FY2023-24 (~35% of basin replenishment from GWRS)

energy_kwh_per_m3.label: Energy Intensity
energy_kwh_per_m3.source: OCWD Annual Report FY2023-24; Leverenz et al. (2011)

leakage_pct.label: System Leakage (NRW)
leakage_pct.source: CDWR benchmarks; estimated 8-10% NRW across OC agencies

capex_usd_per_m3_capacity.label: Capital Cost per m³ Capacity
capex_usd_per_m3_capacity.source: Industry estimate ~USD 480M / 130 MGD; OCWD capital programme data
